articles.title: Turkish President Erdogan receives EU foreign policy chief ahead of NATO summit in Ankara
articles.summary: President Erdogan received EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas and her delegation for a closed-door meeting at the Presidential Complex in Ankara.

articles.title: President Erdogan receives delegation of Catholic bishops in Türkiye
articles.summary: Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdogan received a delegation from the Conference of Catholic Bishops in Türkiye at the presidential complex in Ankara.

articles.title: NATO summit in Ankara to serve as 'strongest platform for sharing experience': President Erdogan
articles.summary: President Erdogan stated that the NATO summit in Ankara on July 7-8 will serve as the strongest platform for sharing experience, speaking at a luncheon in honor of NATO parliamentary speakers.

articles.title: Erdogan says Türkiye, Poland aim to deepen cooperation ahead of NATO summit
articles.summary: President Erdogan said Türkiye and Poland are working to strengthen cooperation as NATO allies, with a new bilateral trade target of $15 billion set between the two countries.

articles.title: Türkiye's President Erdogan announces country's new AI Action Plan
articles.summary: President Erdogan announced Türkiye's new AI Action Plan, which will mobilize at least $10 billion in private-sector investment for data centers, cloud computing, and artificial intelligence infrastructure.
